paper.title_en: Relative-Entropy Flow Across the Page Transition
paper.abstract_en: We develop a computational framework for the quantum relative entropy based on the replica trick and apply it to analyze the evaporation process method of Jackiw-Teitelboim black holes. We show that the relative entropies between the exact radiation state and the Hawking saddle state and the replica wormholes saddle state quantify information-theoretic costs inherent to coarse-grained semiclassical descriptions. During evaporation, the relative entropy for the Hawking saddle increases monotonically, reflecting a progressively higher thermodynamic cost of sustaining the Hawking description. Conversely, the relative entropy associated with the replica wormholes saddle decreases, which indicates that the description of connected geometries becomes progressively more accurate. Moreover, the sign of the difference between the two quantities reverses precisely at the Page time, providing an information-theoretic diagnosis for the transition between competing gravitational saddles. Our results recast the Page transition as a flow of relative entropy costs between competing semi-classical descriptions, revealing an information-theoretic structure underlying the emergence of effective irreversibility in coarse-grained black hole evaporation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在Jackiw-Teitelboim黑洞蒸发框架下，利用复本技巧与复本虫洞鞍点，将Page转变重构为竞争半经典描述之间相对熵成本的流动，兼具理论深度与信息论诊断视角，属于黑洞热力学与引力基础交叉的重要议题，值得进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们基于复本技巧（replica trick）构建了一个量子相对熵的计算框架，并将其应用于分析Jackiw-Teitelboim黑洞的蒸发过程。我们表明，精确辐射态与Hawking鞍点态之间以及复本虫洞（replica wormholes）鞍点态之间的相对熵，量化了粗粒化半经典描述所固有的信息论代价。在蒸发过程中，Hawking鞍点的相对熵单调增加，反映出维持Hawking描述的 thermodynamic 代价逐步升高。相反，与复本虫洞鞍点相关的相对熵减小，这表明对连通几何的描述变得越来越精确。此外，这两个量之差的符号恰好在Page时间发生反转，从而为竞争性引力鞍点之间的转变提供了一个信息论诊断。我们的结果将Page转变重新表述为竞争性半经典描述之间相对熵成本的流动，揭示了粗粒化黑洞蒸发中有效不可逆性出现背后所蕴含的信息论结构。
decision.translation_warning: 原文中“thermodynamic cost”一词的语义存在轻微歧义（可理解为热力学代价或 thermodynamics 意义上的成本），译文按字面直译为“thermodynamic 代价”以保留原词。
